d: Thousands of websites worldwide have gone dark after critical security flaws were discovered in a programming language that powers an estimated 70 percent of websites. The vulnerabilities could allow hackers to steal data or take control of servers, putting around 1.5 million websites at risk. Researchers used AI to uncover the flaws, but details leaked before developers could release their planned fix. Now, governments and organisations are racing to patch vulnerable systems as exploitation attempts mount. So, how dangerous is this security breach, and how much of the internet could be…
